children: Slovakia will cap the retail margin on motor fuels at 0.10 euros per litre from October, as the government seeks measures to ease the impact of high energy market costs caused by conflict in the Middle East, Prime Minister Robert Fico said on Wednesday.
Fico had flagged measures on Tuesday when he said the European Union's executive had failed to tackle soaring fuel prices and urged an emergency summit on the issue.
He reiterated his criticism on Wednesday after a government meeting to decide on measures, which also include cutting second-class train fares by 50% from next month.
